title: Quicklaunch: option to restrict editing of launchers for disabled people request, Remove application option shows even when locked
line: When widgets are locked, Quicklaunch no longer offers to add, edit or remove launchers.
explanation: Quicklaunch only honoured the widget lock for drag and drop. Its launcher context menu still showed Add, Edit and Remove Launcher, the widget's own context menu still showed Add Launcher, and Backspace/Delete on a focused launcher still removed it, so a stray right-click could wipe launchers on a locked panel. The change hides those menu items and ignores the delete keys while Plasmoid.immutable is true, so locking widgets (or kiosk immutability) now protects the launchers; unlocking brings everything back.

commits.message:
applets/quicklaunch: hide launcher editing when widgets are locked

Locking widgets only stopped dragging launchers around, while the context
menus still offered to add, edit and remove launchers and the Delete key
still removed them. Those actions are now hidden or ignored when locked.

BUG: 291146

media.caption: Widgets locked: right-clicking a launcher still offers Add, Edit and Remove Launcher
Widgets locked: only the app's own actions and Configure remain
Widgets unlocked: Add, Edit and Remove Launcher are back
